name: xdz
description: CSS compiler for the Xeno Dead Zone system

scripts.pack: npm run pack:npcs && npm run pack:vehicles && npm run pack:assets && npm run pack:weapons && npm run pack:extragear
scripts.unpack: npm run unpack:npcs && npm run unpack:vehicles && npm run unpack:assets && npm run unpack:weapons && npm run unpack:extragear
scripts.pack:npcs: fvtt package pack npcs --in packs/_source/npcs --out packs --type System --id xdz -v
scripts.unpack:npcs: fvtt package unpack npcs --in packs --out packs/_source/npcs --type System --id xdz -v --clean
scripts.pack:vehicles: fvtt package pack vehicles --in packs/_source/vehicles --out packs --type System --id xdz -v
scripts.unpack:vehicles: fvtt package unpack vehicles --in packs --out packs/_source/vehicles --type System --id xdz -v --clean
scripts.pack:assets: fvtt package pack assets --in packs/_source/assets --out packs --type System --id xdz -v
scripts.unpack:assets: fvtt package unpack assets --in packs --out packs/_source/assets --type System --id xdz -v --clean
scripts.pack:weapons: fvtt package pack weapons --in packs/_source/weapons --out packs --type System --id xdz -v
scripts.unpack:weapons: fvtt package unpack weapons --in packs --out packs/_source/weapons --type System --id xdz -v --clean
scripts.pack:extragear: fvtt package pack extragear --in packs/_source/extragear --out packs --type System --id xdz -v
scripts.unpack:extragear: fvtt package unpack extragear --in packs --out packs/_source/extragear --type System --id xdz -v --clean
